const int dy[] = {0, 1, 0, -1};

inline bool isDigit0(char c) { return c >= '0' && c <= '9'; }
inline bool isDigit1(char c) { return c >= '1' && c <= '9'; }

class Dinic {
public:
    vector<int> adj[MAXV];
    int cap[MAXV][MAXV];
    int dist[MAXV];
    bool used[MAXV];

    Dinic() { memset(cap, 0, sizeof(cap)); }

    void addEdge(int u, int v, int c) {
        adj[u].push_back(v);
        adj[v].push_back(u);
        cap[u][v] = c;
        cap[v][u] = 0;
    }

    bool bfs(int s, int t) {
        memset(dist, -1, sizeof(dist));
        queue<int> q;
        q.push(s);
        dist[s] = 0;
        while (!q.empty() && dist[t] == -1) {
            int u = q.front();
            q.pop();
            for (int v : adj[u]) {
                if (cap[u][v] > 0 && dist[v] == -1) {
                    dist[v] = dist[u] + 1;
                    q.push(v);
                }
            }
        }
        return dist[t] != -1;
    }

    int dfs(int u, int t, int flow) {
        if (u == t) return flow;
        used[u] = true;
        for (int v : adj[u]) {
            if (cap[u][v] > 0 && !used[v] && dist[v] == dist[u] + 1) {
                int got = dfs(v, t, min(flow, cap[u][v]));
                if (got > 0) {
                    cap[u][v] -= got;
                    cap[v][u] += got;
                    return got;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    int maxFlow(int s, int t) {
        int ret = 0;
        while (bfs(s, t)) {
            memset(used, 0, sizeof(used));
            int got;
            while ((got = dfs(s, t, INF)) > 0) ret += got;
        }
        return ret;
    }
};

                int pushed = dfs(v, t, min(flow, cap[u][v]));
                if (pushed > 0) {
                    cap[u][v] -= pushed;
                    cap[v][u] += pushed;
                    return pushed;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    int maxFlow(int s, int t) {
        int ans = 0;
        while (bfs(s, t)) {
            memset(ptr, 0, sizeof(ptr));
            int pushed;
            while ((pushed = dfs(s, t, INF)) > 0) ans += pushed;
        }
        return ans;
    }
};

void zombieBfs(int sx, int sy) {

void sourceEdgeBuilder(int sx, int sy) {

    if (positiveDigit(B[sx][sy]))
